cases.name: discount_threshold
cases.title: Bulk discount not applied at exactly the threshold
cases.diagnosis: The discount function only applies when amount is greater than the threshold, but the spec and tests require it to apply at the threshold (>= 1000). This causes discount(1000) to be 0 and total calculation to be incorrect.
cases.diff:
--- a/pricing.py
+++ b/pricing.py
@@ -13,7 +13,7 @@
 
 def discount(amount):
     """Orders of 1000 or more get 10% off."""
-    if amount > BULK_DISCOUNT_MIN:
+    if amount >= BULK_DISCOUNT_MIN:
         return round(amount * BULK_DISCOUNT_RATE, 2)
     return 0

cases.name: pagination_off_by_one
cases.title: Pagination skips the first page
cases.diagnosis: Pagination uses 1-indexed pages but calculates start offset as page*size, skipping the first page and returning empty for out-of-range pages.
cases.diff:
--- a/pagination.py
+++ b/pagination.py
@@ -22,6 +22,6 @@
         raise ValueError("page starts at 1")
     if size < 1:
         raise ValueError("size must be positive")
-    start = page * size
+    start = (page - 1) * size
     end = start + size
     return Page(items=items[start:end], page=page, size=size, total=len(items))
